description: This file defines the ConfigurationResolver class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for resolving configuration values from environment variables, configuration files, or defaults. It includes methods for reading environment variables, parsing ini configuration files, and handling type conversions.

classes.name: ConfigurationResolver
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve AWS SDK configuration values from environment variables, ini files, or defaults.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves configuration values by checking environment variables, shared config files, or defaults.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Retrieves configuration from environment variables, with type conversion.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Reads configuration values from an ini file, handling profiles and sections.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Determines the user's home directory on Unix or Windows systems.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Returns the default AWS config file location, either from environment variable or default path.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts string values to the specified type: bool or int.

methods.name: retrieveValueFromIniSubsection
methods.description: Fetches nested configuration values from complex ini subsections.
